title: Ekpeye language
description: Distinct Igboid language spoken in Rivers State and Bayelsa State, Nigeria
extract: Ekpeye language is one of many Igbo dialects spoken in Rivers State, Nigeria. According to Roger Blench, Ekpeye is classified as an Igboid language. The Ogba and Ikwerre dialects are closely related to Ekpeye.
